title: FERC Delegated Order — Docket ER02-2001-000: Letter order granting Chicopee Energy BESS LLC's et al. request for an extension of time, until 09/02/2026 to file its 2026 Q2 Electric Quarterly Report under ER02-2001.
text:
SEQ CHAPTER \h \r 1FEDERAL ENERGY REGULATORY COMMISSION
	Washington, D.C. 20426

	OFFICE OF ENFORCEMENT AND REGULATORY ACCOUNTING

	Electric Quarterly Reports	Docket No. ER02-2001-000

September 1, 2026

Reference: Requests for Extension of Time to File 2026 Q2 Electric Quarterly Reports

To whom it may concern:

	Pursuant to the authority delegated to the Director, Division of Analytics and Surveillance under 18 C.F.R. § 375.311, the requests for extension of time to file the 2026 Q2 Electric Quarterly Reports are granted as reflected in the Appendix (attached).

This letter order constitutes final agency action.  Requests for rehearing by the Commission may be filed within 30 days of the date of this order pursuant to 18 C.F.R. § 385.713.

Questions regarding the above order should be emailed to eqr@ferc.gov.

Sincerely,

					for
Sean Collins
Director
Division of Analytics and Surveillance
Office of Enforcement and Regulatory Accounting
